headline: Three more classics replay from a seed: Pac-Man, Frogger and Missile Command ship with 24 proven mutants
lede: Batch 15 of the seedpin rollout moved the last three mechanical arcade titles off raw Math.random: the whole ghost brain, the traffic dice and the warhead dice now ride one seeded stream, ?seed=N replays them exactly — and Missile Command got the restart button it never had.

notes.text: Pac-Man: ghost AI (pen timers, chase BFS, Inky's coin flip, scared wander) extracted to a pure stepGhost on one mulberry32 stream; score now survives GAME OVER like the arcade. pacmancheck 48 green, 12 mutants die.
Frogger: lane dive-phase offsets and the bonus fly house seeded in sim.js — the traffic itself replays. froggercheck 17 green, 8 mutants die.

Missile Command had NO restart path at all — the GAME OVER screen was dead. startRun() now rebuilds cities, silos, score and waves from any key, click or tap. New gate missilecmdcheck: 15 checks, 4 mutants die.

Pin floor 45→48 on #1473; feedbackcheck 223/223. Also verified and recorded on the board: a parallel lane shipped the WEIGHT SURGERY demo (#1493) while Jon's explicit hold was on the issue — evidence carried in STATE for arbitration; slot-a has the fair-horizon rescore (#1506) in flight.
